subject: Request: Bridge note / post‑report coverage and evidentiary checklist
messages:
From: compliance@bluewellhealth.com
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Bridge note covering period after SOC2 report (Mar 31 2027)

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for sharing your SOC 2 Type II (period ended 2027-03-31). Our security team is gating a go‑live and has asked for a bridge/coverage letter that confirms the controls posture from 2027-04-01 through the present. Specifically they want:

- A short bridge letter (signed) that states whether there have been material changes to controls since 2027-03-31.
- A list of the specific control areas being asserted (CC1, CC3, CC5, etc.).
- Relevant evidence we can attach to our file (attestation of recent change reviews, incident log extract for the period, any patching windows).
- Confirmation of who will sign (your SOC contact or external auditor), and whether the auditor will provide any comfort.

Can you confirm turnaround time? We ideally need the letter and evidence by next Wednesday, 2027-06-16. If you need a template or preferred format we can accept PDF or DocuSign.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short sync if that helps.

Best,
Janelle Porter
Sr. Security Manager
BlueWell Health

-----
Attachment: bluewell-ask-20270610.pdf (summary of internal requirements)

Hi Janelle — thanks for the clear note and timeline. Looping in Laura and Kimberly from Security and Priyom from Ops so we can prepare the bridge note + evidentiary package.

Quick answers up front:
- We can produce a customer-facing bridge letter covering 2027-04-01 through 2027-06-15.
- We will include a controls list and an evidence bundle (PDF extracts + control matrix).
- We expect to have a draft by Monday 2027-06-14 and a signed copy by Wednesday 2027-06-16, subject to auditor confirmation below.

Laura / Kimberly / Priyom — can you confirm the set of artifacts you need to bundle? Janelle has asked for incident log extracts and patch/maintenance confirmations; we should also include a short manager assertion confirming no material control changes. Also advise whether Fenwick (our auditor) will sign or we should provide an internal signatory plus the auditor comfort statement.

Janelle — I'll track this and share drafts through the thread; happy to hop on 15m if useful.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com, compliance@bluewellhealth.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Bridge note covering period after SOC2 report (Mar 31 2027)

Thanks Marcus / Janelle — I drafted an evidence checklist and a proposed bridge note outline. Key calls:

1) What we will assert:
- Manager affirmation that there were no material modifications to the control environment that would affect the SOC 2 scope between 2027-04-01 and 2027-06-15.
- A concise list of control categories covered (Logical Access, Change Management, Incident Management, Data Backups).

2) Evidence bundle (recommended):
- Incident log extract (2027-04-01 -> 2027-06-15) — redacted PDF (attachment: incident-log-extract.pdf).
- Patch/maintenance summary for infra (weekly windows) — PDF export.
- Control owner signoff log for any minor configuration changes (if present).
- Updated control matrix (control-matrix-202703.xlsx).
- Manager assertion letter (one page) signed by our Head of Security.

3) Auditor involvement: Fenwick can provide a comfort letter but will not reissue a SOC report. Typically they will:
- Review our manager assertion and confirm they have no knowledge to the contrary (signed comfort letter).
- They will require the evidence bundle to perform that comfort review (their scope is limited).

Timeline: I can assemble the manager assertion and evidence extracts over the weekend and produce a draft bridge letter (company signature) by EOD Monday 2027-06-14. To get Fenwick's comfort letter signed by 2027-06-16 we need to submit the evidence bundle to Katie by Monday morning and have a 24–48 hour turnaround.

Action items:
- Marcus: confirm who should sign the customer-facing PDF (internal Head of Security vs external auditor).
- Janelle: confirm BlueWell accepts a two‑piece delivery (internal assertion + auditor comfort letter).
- Priyom: please export the incident log extract and the patch window summaries as PDF by COB Monday.

Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Security Assurance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: incident-log-extract.pdf (stub), bridge-evidence-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: marcus.lin@redwood.com

All — this plan sounds good. Janelle: we typically deliver a two-part package: (1) a Redwood manager assertion / bridge letter signed by our Head of Security; and (2) Fenwick's comfort letter confirming they have reviewed the evidence and have no knowledge to the contrary. Is that acceptable to you?

Additional ask for the customer-facing letter: please include the exact report reference (SOC 2 Type II, period ended 2027-03-31, report ID: RW-SOC2-2027-03). Also add one sentence clarifying that the bridge note is an assertion limited in scope and is not a substitute for a SOC 2 report.

Kimberly — please prepare a 1‑page manager assertion for signature and collate the evidence attachments. Priyom — please upload the incident extract + patch summaries to the Drive link and flag any items that might need redaction.

Katie — I've copied you. Laura mentioned Fenwick can provide a comfort letter if we send the evidence package Monday AM; please confirm availability and turnaround.

Thanks everyone — I'll aim to circulate a draft by EOD today for internal review.

Marcus

Attachment: control-matrix-202703.xlsx

From: katie@fenwickadvisors.com (Fenwick Advisors, auditor)
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@bluewellhealth.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: Bridge note covering period after SOC2 report (Mar 31 2027)

Marcus / Laura — thanks for the heads up and for looping us in. Fenwick can provide a limited comfort statement addressing our review of the evidence bundle, with the following notes:

- We will prepare a short comfort letter confirming that, based on our review of the submitted artifacts, we have no knowledge that Redwood made material changes to controls that would affect the SOC 2 scope during 2027-04-01 to 2027-06-15.
- We cannot reissue the SOC 2 report nor provide an opinion equivalent to a Type II report; our comfort statement is limited to the evidence presented.

Required from Redwood for our review:
- Manager assertion (signed).
- Incident extract (unredacted to Fenwick, redacted for customer delivery as needed).
- Control matrix and change log for the period.
- Any remediation records for incidents during the period.

Turnaround and next steps:
- Please deliver the evidence bundle via the Drive link before 2027-06-15 10:00 PT. We will prioritise review and aim to return a signed comfort letter by 2027-06-16 EOD.
- Attached is our bridgenote template and required reviewer checklist.

Regards,
Katie Mallory
Principal, Fenwick Advisors
katie@fenwickadvisors.com
